text: Eating well, moving regularly, and getting enough rest are the building blocks of a healthy life. A balanced diet, rich in fruits, vegetables, and whole grains, gives your body the energy it needs, while daily exercise—even a brisk walk—strengthens your heart and muscles. However, true health also includes your mind. Getting seven to eight hours of quality sleep each night helps you recharge, and taking time for yourself reduces stress. Equally important is maintaining a work-life balance; setting boundaries between your job and personal time prevents burnout. Small, steady changes, like stretching in the morning or cooking a healthy meal, can lead to lasting improvements. Remember, the goal is not perfection but consistency—your body and mind will thank you.
